Domain: Physical — Resource: Stamina — Specialty: Adaptation — Specialty Condition: Unstable

Supernatural transformation and deliberate physical adaptation — altering the body for weapons, armor, movement, senses, size, or regeneration suited to the current problem.

Adaptation

A Gestalt Action's Rider may offer an Adaptation; after resolving, assume it or retain your current one. Maintain only one Adaptation at a time — assuming another ends the previous. Adaptations may carry a Stamina upkeep cost, paid at the end of your Turn or the Adaptation ends.

Expertises

  • Armament
  • Regeneration
  • Awareness
  • Locomotion
  • Metabolism
  • Plasticity
  • Integration

Subtypes

  • Predator
  • Bulwark
  • Titan
  • Strider
  • Chimera
